articles.summary: Canada Goose Holdings Inc. (NYSE, TSX: GOOS) plans to announce results for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, which ended September 27, 2026, before markets open on Thursday, November 5, 2026. The Company will host a conference call and webcast to discuss second quarter fiscal 2027 results at 8:30am ET on Thursday, November 5, 2026. A live webcast of the conference call will be available on the company’s website at http://investor.canadagoose.com . The conference call can be accessed by using the following link: Canada Goose Q2 2027 Earnings Call . After registering, an email including the conference call link will be sent to join the live call. An archived replay of the webcast will be available shortly after the conclusion of the call. articles.summary: Experimental in proportion, texture and colour, the collection introduces leather and footwear to Snow Goose by Canada Goose for the first time Today, Canada Goose unveils Axis of Endurance , the Fall/Winter 2026 Snow Goose by Canada Goose collection from Creative Director, Haider Ackermann. The collection launches with a global campaign shot by Julie Joubert, featuring Mariane Godoy​, Samvel Tadevossian, Simon Franck​, Marin Fournier​, Eliot Cassignat and Cesar Salmon. Snow Goose by Canada Goose Fall/Winter 2026 For this season, Ackermann considers endurance as both physical and internal: the quiet tension of staying with something longer than comfort allows, until instinct takes over. articles.title: Haider Ackermann Presents Axis of Endurance, a Study in Strength and Form for Snow Goose by Canada Goose Fall/Winter 2026
